title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Sending Copies of Criminal Case Judgments to the Litigant's Affiliated Unit
keywords_en: Supreme People's Court; regarding the transfer of criminal cases
full_text_en:
Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Sending Copies of Criminal Case Judgments to the Parties' Work Units

Fa (Yan) Fa [1991] No. 43

To the High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government, and the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army:

In order to coordinate with the labor and personnel management of the work units of the parties involved in criminal cases and to promote the comprehensive management of public security, henceforth, in criminal cases adjudicated by the people's courts, after the judgment becomes effective, the people's court that renders the final judgment or ruling shall promptly send copies of the effective judgment or ruling to the work unit of the party concerned. If the party originally had no work unit, copies may be sent to the township (town) government or the subdistrict office of the party's former domicile.

December 20, 1991
